record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, expand the causal uniform pooling window from four to eight encoder states while retaining the 0.8 current-state/0.2 pooled-state blend. A broader observed-context summary may capture persistent interests without the aggressive recency weighting that regressed previously. Normalize over real positions only and apply the same causal readout at every training position and in inference. Preserve history length, positional representation, embeddings, backbone, scoring, loss and optimizer; update predictor-writer metadata.

category_rationales.rationale: Expand uniform causal pooling from four to eight encoder states across all four category models, retaining the 0.8 current-state/0.2 pooled-state blend. Broader observed context may better capture persistent interests. Existing nonpadding normalization and final-real-position inference remain consistent through the shared model class; synchronize saved and predictor metadata.
